Script.name: m_enchanter_core
Script.script:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- m_Enchanter - Mudlet enchanting helper backed by DINV persistence ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
m_Enchanter = m_Enchanter or {} m_Enchanter.version = "1.0.0" m_Enchanter.aliases = m_Enchanter.aliases or {} m_Enchanter.triggers = m_Enchanter.triggers or {} m_Enchanter.timers = m_Enchanter.timers or {} m_Enchanter.events = m_Enchanter.events or {} m_Enchanter.pending_identifies = m_Enchanter.pending_identifies or {}
m_Enchanter.settings = m_Enchanter.settings or { debug = false, reporting_on = true, report_channel = "echo", quiet = false, focus_ignore = false, }
m_Enchanter.focus = m_Enchanter.focus or { status = "unknown" } m_Enchanter.pending_command = m_Enchanter.pending_command or "" m_Enchanter.pending_item_id = m_Enchanter.pending_item_id or "" m_Enchanter.last = m_Enchanter.last or nil
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- General helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function startsWith(value, prefix) return tostring(value or ""):sub(1, #prefix) == prefix end
local function tableCount(t) local n = 0 if type(t) == "table" then for _ in pairs(t) do n = n + 1 end end return n end
local function shallowCopy(t) local out = {} if type(t) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(t) do out[k] = v end end return out end
local function stripColors(text) if dbot and dbot.stripColors then return dbot.stripColors(text) end text = tostring(text or "") text = text:gsub("@@", "\001AT\001") text = text:gsub("@x%d+", "") text = text:gsub("@[%a]", "") text = text:gsub("\027%[[%d;]*m", "") text = text:gsub("\001AT\001", "@") return text end
function m_Enchanter.convertColors(text) if dbot and dbot.convertColors then return dbot.convertColors(text) end
local map = { ["@w"] = "<ansi_white>", ["@W"] = "<white>", ["@r"] = "<ansi_red>", ["@R"] = "<ansi_light_red>", ["@g"] = "<ansi_green>", ["@G"] = "<ansi_light_green>", ["@y"] = "<ansi_yellow>", ["@Y"] = "<ansi_light_yellow>", ["@b"] = "<ansi_blue>", ["@B"] = "<ansi_light_blue>", ["@m"] = "<ansi_magenta>", ["@M"] = "<ansi_light_magenta>", ["@c"] = "<ansi_cyan>", ["@C"] = "<ansi_light_cyan>", ["@d"] = "<ansi_black>", ["@D"] = "<ansi_light_black>", }
text = tostring(text or "") text = text:gsub("@@", "\001AT\001") text = text:gsub("@x%d+", "") for code, color in pairs(map) do text = text:gsub(code:gsub("@", "%%@"), color) end text = text:gsub("\001AT\001", "@") return text end
function m_Enchanter.print(text) cecho(m_Enchanter.convertColors(tostring(text or "")) .. "\n") end
function m_Enchanter.info(text) m_Enchanter.print("@C[m_enchanter]@w " .. tostring(text or "")) end
function m_Enchanter.warn(text) m_Enchanter.print("@Y[m_enchanter]@w " .. tostring(text or "")) end
function m_Enchanter.debug(text) if m_Enchanter.settings.debug then m_Enchanter.print("@D[m_enchanter DEBUG] " .. tostring(text or "") .. "@w") end end
local function quoteTarget(target) target = trim(target) if target == "" then return target end if target:match("^%d+$") then return target end if target:find("%s") then return "'" .. target:gsub("'", "\\'") .. "'" end return target end
local function sendGameCommand(command) if m_Enchanter.settings.quiet then if sendSilent then sendSilent(command) else send(command, false) end else send(command) end end
local function sendReportLine(coloredText) local channel = trim(m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo") if channel == "" then channel = "echo" end
if channel:lower() == "echo" then m_Enchanter.print(coloredText) return end
local command = channel .. " " .. tostring(coloredText or "") local mudChannels = { clan = true, say = true, gtell = true, gt = true, spouse = true, }
if mudChannels[channel:lower()] then send(command, false) elseif expandAlias then expandAlias(command, false) else send(command, false) end end
local function runDinvCommand(command) if expandAlias then expandAlias(command, false) else send(command, false) end end
local function niceJoin(list) list = shallowCopy(list) if #list == 0 then return "" end if #list == 1 then return list[1] end local last = table.remove(list) return table.concat(list, ", ") .. ", and " .. last end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Persistence ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getHomeDir() if getMudletHomeDir then return getMudletHomeDir() end return "." end
local function ensureDirectory(path) path = tostring(path or ""):gsub("\\", "/") if path == "" then return false end
local ok, lfsLib = pcall(require, "lfs") local fs = ok and lfsLib or lfs if not fs then return false end
local current = "" local drive = path:match("^%a:") if drive then current = drive path = path:sub(3) elseif startsWith(path, "/") then current = "/" end
for segment in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do if current == "" then current = segment elseif current == "/" then current = current .. segment else current = current .. "/" .. segment end
if fs.attributes(current, "mode") ~= "directory" then fs.mkdir(current) end end
return true end
function m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() return getHomeDir() .. "/persistence/" end
function m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath() return m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "m_enchanter.state" end
local function saveLuaTable(path, tableName, value) local dir = path:match("^(.*[/\\])[^/\\]+$") if dir then ensureDirectory(dir) end
local function serialize(v, indent) indent = indent or 0 local tv = type(v) if tv == "string" then return string.format("%q", v) elseif tv == "number" or tv == "boolean" then return tostring(v) elseif tv == "table" then local parts = { "{" } local nextIndent = indent + 4 local keys = {} for k in pairs(v) do table.insert(keys, k) end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end) for _, k in ipairs(keys) do local keyText if type(k) == "string" and k:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then keyText = k else keyText = "[" .. serialize(k, nextIndent) .. "]" end table.insert(parts, string.rep(" ", nextIndent) .. keyText .. " = " .. serialize(v[k], nextIndent) .. ",") end table.insert(parts, string.rep(" ", indent) .. "}") return table.concat(parts, "\n") end return "nil" end
local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not save settings: " .. tostring(err)) return false end f:write(tableName .. " = " .. serialize(value, 0) .. "\n") f:close() return true end
local function loadLuaFile(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return nil end local content = f:read("*a") f:close() if not content or content == "" then return nil end
local env = { inv = { items = {} } } setmetatable(env, { __index = _G })
local chunk, err if loadstring then chunk, err = loadstring(content) if chunk and setfenv then setfenv(chunk, env) end else chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. path, "t", env) end
if not chunk then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not parse persistence file '" .. tostring(path) .. "': " .. tostring(err)) return nil end
local ok, runErr = pcall(chunk) if not ok then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not load persistence file '" .. tostring(path) .. "': " .. tostring(runErr)) return nil end
return env end
function m_Enchanter.saveSettings() local data = { debug = m_Enchanter.settings.debug and true or false, reporting_on = m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on and true or false, report_channel = m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo", quiet = m_Enchanter.settings.quiet and true or false, focus_ignore = m_Enchanter.settings.focus_ignore and true or false, } saveLuaTable(m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath(), "m_EnchanterSettings", data) end
function m_Enchanter.loadSettings() local env = loadLuaFile(m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath()) local data = env and env.m_EnchanterSettings if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
for k, v in pairs(data) do m_Enchanter.settings[k] = v end m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel = m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo" end
function m_Enchanter.itemStatePaths() local paths = {} local seen = {} local function add(path) if path and path ~= "" and not seen[path] then seen[path] = true table.insert(paths, path) end end
add(m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "inv-items.state") add(m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "dinv/inv-items.state")
if dbot and dbot.backup and dbot.backup.getCurrentDir then local ok, dir = pcall(dbot.backup.getCurrentDir) if ok and dir then add(dir .. "inv-items.state") end end
return paths end
function m_Enchanter.loadItemsFromPersistence() if inv and inv.items and inv.items.loadPersistentItemsTable then local ok, items = pcall(inv.items.loadPersistentItemsTable) if ok and type(items) == "table" and tableCount(items) > 0 then return items, "dinv" end end
for _, path in ipairs(m_Enchanter.itemStatePaths()) do local env = loadLuaFile(path) local items = env and env.inv and env.inv.items and env.inv.items.table if type(items) == "table" and tableCount(items) > 0 then return items, path end end
return nil, nil end
function m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() if inv and inv.items and type(inv.items.table) == "table" and tableCount(inv.items.table) > 0 then return inv.items.table, "live" end
if inv and inv.items and inv.items.load then pcall(inv.items.load) if type(inv.items.table) == "table" and tableCount(inv.items.table) > 0 then return inv.items.table, "dinv-load" end end
local items, source = m_Enchanter.loadItemsFromPersistence() if items and inv and inv.items and (type(inv.items.table) ~= "table" or tableCount(inv.items.table) == 0) then inv.items.table = items end return items, source end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- DINV access ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.dinvReady() return inv and inv.items and inv.items.search and inv.items.displayResults end
function m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() if not m_Enchanter.dinvReady() then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV is not loaded. Load DINV first; numeric ids can still be read from persistence if inv-items.state exists.") return false end m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() return true end
function m_Enchanter.runDinvSearch(query) query = trim(query) if not m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() then return false end
if inv.cli and inv.cli.main then inv.cli.main("search " .. query) return true end
local itemIds, retval = inv.items.search(query) if retval == 0 or retval == nil then if inv.items.sort then inv.items.sort(itemIds) end inv.items.displayResults(itemIds, "basic") return true end
return false end
function m_Enchanter.searchItems(query) if not m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() then return nil, -1 end
local itemIds, retval = inv.items.search(query) itemIds = itemIds or {} if retval == 0 or retval == nil then if inv.items.sort then inv.items.sort(itemIds) end end return itemIds, retval end
function m_Enchanter.displayItemIds(itemIds) if not itemIds or #itemIds == 0 then return end if inv and inv.items and inv.items.displayResults then inv.items.displayResults(itemIds, "basic") end end
function m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return nil end
if inv and inv.items and inv.items.getItem then local item = inv.items.getItem(objId) if item then return item, "live" end end
local items, source = m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() if type(items) == "table" then local item = items[objId] or items[tonumber(objId)] if item then return item, source or "persistence" end end
return nil, nil end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Item/stat helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local fieldCandidates = { id = { "id" }, name = { "name" }, colorName = { "colorname", "colorName", "coloredName" }, flags = { "flags" }, enchants = { "enchants", "enchantments", "enchantData", "enchantDetails" }, type = { "type" }, level = { "level" }, wearable = { "wearable" }, location = { "location", "loc" }, identifyLevel = { "identifyLevel", "idlevel" }, }
local function getStat(item, key) if not item then return nil end local stats = item.stats or item local candidates = fieldCandidates[key] or { key } for _, field in ipairs(candidates) do if stats[field] ~= nil then return stats[field] end if item[field] ~= nil then return item[field] end end return nil end
local function normalizeTokenText(text) text = stripColors(text):lower() text = text:gsub("[,;|/]+", " ") return text end
local function hasToken(text, token) token = tostring(token or ""):lower() for word in normalizeTokenText(text):gmatch("%S+") do if word == token then return true end end return false end
local function cleanDisplayName(name) name = tostring(name or "") name = name:gsub("%s+[A-Z][a-z]+%s+%+?%-?%d+%s*%(removable[^%)]*%).*", "") name = name:gsub("%s+%(removable[^%)]*%)%s*", "") return trim(name) end
local function itemIsInInventory(item) return tostring(getStat(item, "location") or ""):lower() == "inventory" end
local function normalizeEnchantKind(value) value = tostring(value or ""):lower() if value:find("solid") then return "solidify" elseif value:find("reson") then return "resonate" elseif value:find("illum") then return "illuminate" end return nil end
local function addEnchant(details, kind, value, removable) kind = normalizeEnchantKind(kind) if not kind then return end details[kind] = details[kind] or {} table.insert(details[kind], { value = trim(value or ""), removable = trim(removable or ""), }) end
local function parseEnchantString(details, text) text = tostring(text or "") if text == "" then return end
for line in text:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do local chunks = {} if line:find(":", 1, true) then table.insert(chunks, line) else for part in line:gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(chunks, part) end end if #chunks == 0 then table.insert(chunks, line) end
for _, chunk in ipairs(chunks) do local kind = normalizeEnchantKind(chunk) if kind then local removable = chunk:match("%((.-)%)") or "" local value = chunk:match(":%s*(.-)%s*%(") or chunk:match(":%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if value:lower():find("removable", 1, true) then value = "" end addEnchant(details, kind, value, removable) end end end end
local function parseEnchantTable(details, value, impliedKind) if type(value) ~= "table" then if type(value) == "string" then local kind = impliedKind or normalizeEnchantKind(value) local removable = value:match("%((.-)%)") or value if kind then addEnchant(details, kind, "", removable) else parseEnchantString(details, value) end end return end
local hasNumeric = false for k in pairs(value) do if type(k) == "number" then hasNumeric = true break end end
if hasNumeric then for _, entry in ipairs(value) do parseEnchantTable(details, entry, impliedKind) end return end
local kind = impliedKind or normalizeEnchantKind(value.kind or value.name or value.type or "") local removable = value.removable or value.remove or value.removal or value.source or value[2] or "" local statValue = value.value or value.stat or value.mod or value.amount or value[1] or "" if kind then addEnchant(details, kind, statValue, removable) else for k, v in pairs(value) do parseEnchantTable(details, v, normalizeEnchantKind(k)) end end end
local function getEnchantDetails(item) local details = { solidify = {}, resonate = {}, illuminate = {}, } local raw = getStat(item, "enchants") if type(raw) == "table" then parseEnchantTable(details, raw, nil) elseif type(raw) == "string" then parseEnchantString(details, raw) end return details end
local function hasEnchant(details, kind) local list = details and details[kind] return type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 end
local function removableText(raw) raw = tostring(raw or ""):lower() if raw == "" then return "" end if raw:find("tp", 1, true) then return "@r(removable with TP only)@w" end if raw:find("enchanter", 1, true) then return "@y(removable by enchanter)@w" end if raw:find("removable", 1, true) then return "@y(" .. raw .. ")@w" end return "" end
local function formatEnchantDetails(details, kind) local list = details and details[kind] if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then return nil end
local values = {} local removable = "" for _, entry in ipairs(list) do if entry.value and entry.value ~= "" then table.insert(values, entry.value) end local rt = removableText(entry.removable) if rt ~= "" then removable = rt end end
if #values > 0 then return "@C" .. table.concat(values, ", ") .. (removable ~= "" and (" " .. removable) or "") .. "@w" end if removable ~= "" then return "@CEnchanted@w " .. removable end return "@CAlready enchanted.@w" end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Analysis ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.buildAnalysis(objId, item) local flags = tostring(getStat(item, "flags") or "") local details = getEnchantDetails(item)
local hasInvis = hasToken(flags, "invis") local hasHum = hasToken(flags, "hum") local hasGlow = hasToken(flags, "glow") local hasSolidified = hasToken(flags, "solidified") or hasEnchant(details, "solidify") local hasResonated = hasToken(flags, "resonated") or hasEnchant(details, "resonate") local hasIlluminated = hasToken(flags, "illuminated") or hasEnchant(details, "illuminate")
local colorName = getStat(item, "colorName") or getStat(item, "name") or ("item " .. tostring(objId)) colorName = cleanDisplayName(colorName) local plainName = cleanDisplayName(stripColors(colorName)) if plainName == "" then plainName = "item " .. tostring(objId) end
local lines = {} local flagsToToggle = {}
local solidifyStatus if hasSolidified then solidifyStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "solidify") or "@CAlready solidified.@w" elseif hasInvis then solidifyStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" else solidifyStatus = "@RNeeds 'invis' flag ON@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "invis") end table.insert(lines, "@D- @wSolidify: " .. solidifyStatus)
local resonateStatus if hasResonated then resonateStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "resonate") or "@CAlready resonated.@w" elseif hasHum then resonateStatus = "@y(Normal) No stats@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "hum") else resonateStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" end table.insert(lines, "@D- @wResonate: " .. resonateStatus)
local illuminateStatus if hasIlluminated then illuminateStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "illuminate") or "@CAlready illuminated.@w" elseif hasGlow then illuminateStatus = "@y(Normal) No stats@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "glow") else illuminateStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" end table.insert(lines, "@D- @wIlluminate: " .. illuminateStatus)
local target = tostring(objId or plainName) local pending = "" if #flagsToToggle > 0 then pending = "setflag " .. quoteTarget(target) .. " " .. table.concat(flagsToToggle, " ") end
return { id = tostring(objId or ""), item = item, colorName = colorName, plainName = plainName, flags = flags, lines = lines, pending = pending, hasInvis = hasInvis, hasHum = hasHum, hasGlow = hasGlow, hasSolidified = hasSolidified, hasResonated = hasResonated, hasIlluminated = hasIlluminated, } end
function m_Enchanter.displayAnalysis(analysis) local title = "@DEnchantment Analysis for @w" .. analysis.colorName .. "@D (@Y" .. analysis.id .. "@D):@w" local contentLines = shallowCopy(analysis.lines) local commandLine = analysis.pending ~= "" and ("@DSuggested eqsetflags:@w @Y" .. analysis.pending .. "@w") or nil
local maxw = #stripColors(title) for _, line in ipairs(contentLines) do local width = #stripColors(line) if width > maxw then maxw = width end end if commandLine and #stripColors(commandLine) > maxw then maxw = #stripColors(commandLine) end local w = maxw + 4
local border = "<steel_blue>" local reset = "<reset>" local top = border .. "." .. string.rep("-", w) .. "." .. reset local bot = border .. "'" .. string.rep("-", w) .. "'" .. reset local sep = border .. "|-" .. string.rep("-", w - 2) .. "-|" .. reset
m_Enchanter.print(top) m_Enchanter.print(border .. "| " .. reset .. title .. string.rep(" ", w - #stripColors(title) - 1) .. border .. "|" .. reset) m_Enchanter.print(sep) for _, line in ipairs(contentLines) do local pad = string.rep(" ", w - #stripColors(line) - 2) m_Enchanter.print(border .. "| " .. reset .. line .. pad .. " " .. border .. "|" .. reset) end if commandLine then m_Enchanter.print(sep) local pad = string.rep(" ", w - #stripColors(commandLine) - 2) m_Enchanter.print(border .. "| " .. reset .. commandLine .. pad .. " " .. border .. "|" .. reset) end m_Enchanter.print(bot) end
function m_Enchanter.reportAnalysis(analysis) if not m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on then return end
local parts = {} for _, line in ipairs(analysis.lines or {}) do local part = line:gsub("^@D%- @w", "") table.insert(parts, part) end
local name = (analysis.colorName and analysis.colorName ~= "") and analysis.colorName or analysis.plainName sendReportLine(name .. " - " .. table.concat(parts, ", ")) end
function m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, options) options = options or {} objId = tostring(objId or ""):match("^(%d+)$") if not objId then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqanalyze <id|name>") return nil end
local item, source = m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) if not item then m_Enchanter.warn("No DINV persistence entry found for id " .. tostring(objId) .. ". Run 'dinv search " .. tostring(objId) .. "' or refresh DINV.") return nil end
m_Enchanter.debug("Analyzing id " .. tostring(objId) .. " from " .. tostring(source or "unknown")) local analysis = m_Enchanter.buildAnalysis(objId, item) m_Enchanter.last = analysis m_Enchanter.pending_command = analysis.pending or "" m_Enchanter.pending_item_id = analysis.id or ""
if options.display ~= false then m_Enchanter.displayAnalysis(analysis) end if options.report ~= false then m_Enchanter.reportAnalysis(analysis) end
return analysis end
function m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(query, options) options = options or {} query = trim(query) if query == "" then return nil end
if query:match("^%d+$") then local item = m_Enchanter.findItemById(query) if item then return query end m_Enchanter.warn("No DINV persistence entry found for id " .. query .. ".") return nil end
local itemIds, retval = m_Enchanter.searchItems(query) if not itemIds then return nil end
if options.displaySearch or #itemIds ~= 1 then m_Enchanter.runDinvSearch(query) end
if #itemIds == 1 then return tostring(itemIds[1]) elseif #itemIds > 1 and options.warnMultiple ~= false then m_Enchanter.warn("Multiple DINV matches for '" .. query .. "'. Refine the name or use an id.") end return nil end
function m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(query, options) options = options or {} query = trim(query) if query == "" then return nil end
local itemIds = m_Enchanter.searchItems(query) if not itemIds then return nil end
local inventoryIds = {} for _, objId in ipairs(itemIds) do local item = m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) if item and itemIsInInventory(item) then table.insert(inventoryIds, tostring(objId)) end end
if #inventoryIds == 1 then return inventoryIds[1] elseif #inventoryIds > 1 then m_Enchanter.displayItemIds(inventoryIds) if options.warnMultiple ~= false then m_Enchanter.warn("Multiple inventory matches for '" .. query .. "'. Refine the name or use an id.") end return nil end
return m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(query, options) end
function m_Enchanter.eqAnalyze(rawArg) local arg = trim(rawArg) if arg == "" or arg:lower() == "help" then m_Enchanter.showHelp() return end
local debugMode = arg:match("^debug%s+(on|off)$") if debugMode then m_Enchanter.settings.debug = (debugMode == "on") m_Enchanter.saveSettings() m_Enchanter.info("Debug mode is now " .. (m_Enchanter.settings.debug and "ON" or "OFF") .. ".") return end
if arg:match("^%d+$") then m_Enchanter.analyzeId(arg) return end
local objId = m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(arg, { displaySearch = true, warnMultiple = false }) if objId then m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId) end end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Commands and settings ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.showHelp() m_Enchanter.print([[@Y m_Enchanter - Mudlet/DINV enchanting helper ============================================ @WCOMMANDS:@w @Geqa <id>@w Analyze a persisted DINV item by id. @Geqa <name|partial>@w Run @Gdinv search <query>@w; analyze only when exactly one row matches. @Geqsetflags@w Show the prepared setflag command, if any. @Geqsetflags confirm@w Execute the prepared setflag command. @Geqenchant [id|name]@w Cast permitted enchants from the latest DINV-backed analysis. @Geqenchant fast <id|name>@w Cast Solidify, Resonate, and Illuminate without gating. @Geqdisenchant [id|name] <params>@w Params: solidify, resonate, illuminate, all.
@Geqfocus@w Check Enchanter's focus. @Geqfocusignore <on|off>@w Allow enchanting while focus is unknown/down.
@Geqreport <on|off>@w Toggle local/channel analysis reporting. @Geqreportchannel <channel>@w Set report channel. Use @Gecho@w for local output. @Geqquiet <on|off>@w Toggle quiet command sending where Mudlet supports it. @Geqa debug <on|off>@w Toggle debug output. @Geqa help@w Show this help and current settings. ]])
local last = m_Enchanter.last m_Enchanter.print("@YCurrent Settings:@w") m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W Reporting: @G%s@w", m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on and "ON" or "OFF")) m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W Report channel: @G%s@w", m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo")) m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W Debug: @G%s@w", m_Enchanter.settings.debug and "ON" or "OFF")) m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W Quiet mode: @G%s@w", m_Enchanter.settings.quiet and "ON" or "OFF")) m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W Focus ignore: @G%s@w", m_Enchanter.settings.focus_ignore and "ON" or "OFF")) m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W Focus state: @G%s@w", tostring(m_Enchanter.focus.status or "unknown"):upper())) m_Enchanter.print(string.format("@W Last analyzed: @G%s@w", last and (last.plainName .. " (" .. last.id .. ")") or "(none)")) end
function m_Enchanter.eqSetFlags(arg) arg = trim(arg) if arg == "confirm" then if m_Enchanter.pending_command ~= "" then local cmd = m_Enchanter.pending_command local objId = m_Enchanter.pending_item_id m_Enchanter.info("Executing: " .. cmd) m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, function() sendGameCommand(cmd) m_Enchanter.schedulePostOperationIdentify(objId, 0.5, { kind = "analysis" }) end) m_Enchanter.pending_command = "" m_Enchanter.pending_item_id = "" else m_Enchanter.warn("No command to confirm. Use 'eqanalyze <id|name>' first.") end return end
if m_Enchanter.pending_command ~= "" then m_Enchanter.info("Current command is: " .. m_Enchanter.pending_command) else m_Enchanter.warn("No command is currently set. Use 'eqanalyze <id|name>' first.") end end
function m_Enchanter.setReport(onoff) m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on = (onoff == "on") m_Enchanter.saveSettings() m_Enchanter.info("Enchant reporting is now " .. (m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on and "ON" or "OFF") .. ".") end
function m_Enchanter.setReportChannel(channel) channel = trim(channel) if channel == "" then channel = "echo" end m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel = channel m_Enchanter.saveSettings() m_Enchanter.info("Enchant report channel set to: " .. channel) end
function m_Enchanter.setQuiet(onoff) m_Enchanter.settings.quiet = (onoff == "on") m_Enchanter.saveSettings() m_Enchanter.info("Quiet mode is now " .. (m_Enchanter.settings.quiet and "ON" or "OFF") .. ".") end
function m_Enchanter.eqSetupRace() m_Enchanter.warn("eqsetup race is no longer used. m_Enchanter reads already-identified DINV persistence instead of sending identify/lore.") end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Focus ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function clearFocusTimers() for _, key in ipairs({ "warn", "expire" }) do local timerId = m_Enchanter.timers and m_Enchanter.timers[key] if timerId then pcall(killTimer, timerId) m_Enchanter.timers[key] = nil end end end
local function warnFocus30() m_Enchanter.print("@YEnchanter's focus @Dis about to expire in @R30 SECONDS!@w") m_Enchanter.print("@YEnchanter's focus @Dis about to expire in @R30 SECONDS!@w") m_Enchanter.print("@YEnchanter's focus @Dis about to expire in @R30 SECONDS!@w") end
function m_Enchanter.markFocusDown() m_Enchanter.focus.status = "down" m_Enchanter.warn("Enchanter's focus has expired. Enchant commands disabled.") end
function m_Enchanter.scheduleFocus(seconds) clearFocusTimers() seconds = tonumber(seconds) or 0 if seconds <= 30 then warnFocus30() else m_Enchanter.timers.warn = tempTimer(seconds - 30, warnFocus30) end m_Enchanter.timers.expire = tempTimer(seconds, function() m_Enchanter.markFocusDown() end) end
function m_Enchanter.onFocusTimer(mm, ss) local seconds = (tonumber(mm) or 0) * 60 + (tonumber(ss) or 0) m_Enchanter.focus.status = "up" m_Enchanter.debug(string.format("Focus up, %02d:%02d remaining.", tonumber(mm) or 0, tonumber(ss) or 0)) m_Enchanter.scheduleFocus(seconds) end
function m_Enchanter.onNoAffects() clearFocusTimers() m_Enchanter.focus.status = "down" cecho("\n") m_Enchanter.warn("No affects found: Enchanter's focus DOWN. Enchant commands disabled.") end
function m_Enchanter.onFocusFaded() clearFocusTimers() m_Enchanter.focus.status = "down" m_Enchanter.warn("Your Enchanter's focus has faded. Enchant commands disabled.") end
function m_Enchanter.enableSaffectsTipGag() if m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip then pcall(killTrigger, m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip) m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip = nil end if m_Enchanter.timers.saffectsTip then pcall(killTimer, m_Enchanter.timers.saffectsTip) m_Enchanter.timers.saffectsTip = nil end
local triggerId = tempRegexTrigger( [[^Use 'saffects' to see a short version of your affects\.$]], function() if deleteLine then deleteLine() end end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip = triggerId
m_Enchanter.timers.saffectsTip = tempTimer(0.5, function() if m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip then pcall(killTrigger, m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip) m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip = nil end m_Enchanter.timers.saffectsTip = nil end) end
function m_Enchanter.eqFocus() m_Enchanter.enableSaffectsTipGag() sendGameCommand("aff focus") end
function m_Enchanter.eqFocusIgnore(onoff) m_Enchanter.settings.focus_ignore = (onoff == "on") m_Enchanter.saveSettings() if m_Enchanter.settings.focus_ignore then m_Enchanter.warn("@RWARNING@w: Focus ignore ENABLED. You can enchant without focus.") else m_Enchanter.info("Focus ignore disabled. Enchanting requires active focus.") end end
function m_Enchanter.focusAllowsEnchant() if m_Enchanter.settings.focus_ignore then return true end if m_Enchanter.focus.status == "up" then return true end if m_Enchanter.focus.status == "down" then m_Enchanter.warn("Cannot enchant: Enchanter's focus is DOWN. Use 'eqfocus' or 'eqfocusignore on'.") return false end m_Enchanter.warn("Cannot enchant: Focus status is UNKNOWN. Run 'eqfocus' first or use 'eqfocusignore on'.") return false end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Enchanting/disenchanting ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.sendAndNote(command) sendGameCommand(command) m_Enchanter.print("@C -> Sent: @w" .. command) end
local function reportRemovedEnchants(objId, context) context = context or {} local analysis = m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, { display = false, report = false }) if not m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on then return end
local names = context.removedNames or {} if #names == 0 then return end
local itemName = (analysis and analysis.plainName) or context.plainName or ("item " .. tostring(objId)) local msg = (#names == 1) and ("Removed " .. names[1] .. " from " .. itemName) or (niceJoin(names) .. " removed from " .. itemName) sendReportLine(msg) end
function m_Enchanter.finishPostIdentify(objId, context) context = context or {} local kind = context.kind or "analysis"
if kind == "disenchant" then reportRemovedEnchants(objId, context) return end
local analysis = m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, { display = false, report = false }) if analysis then m_Enchanter.reportAnalysis(analysis) end end
function m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyComplete(eventName, objId) if objId == nil and tostring(eventName or "") ~= "DINV.identifyComplete" then objId = eventName end
objId = tostring(objId or ""):match("^(%d+)$") if not objId then return end
local pending = m_Enchanter.pending_identifies and m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] if not pending then return end
m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] = nil m_Enchanter.finishPostIdentify(objId, pending.context) end
function m_Enchanter.queuePostIdentifyReport(objId, context) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return end
m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] = { context = context or {}, startedAt = os.time(), }
tempTimer(2, function() if not (m_Enchanter.pending_identifies and m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId]) then return end
m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] = nil m_Enchanter.warn("DINV identify completion event was not received within 2 seconds for item " .. objId .. "; skipped post-operation report to avoid reading stale item data.") end) end
function m_Enchanter.schedulePostOperationIdentify(objId, delay, context) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return end
delay = tonumber(delay) or 0 tempTimer(delay, function() m_Enchanter.queuePostIdentifyReport(objId, context) runDinvCommand("dinv identify " .. objId) end) end
function m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, callback) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return end
local item = m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) local delay = 0 if not (item and itemIsInInventory(item)) then runDinvCommand("dinv get " .. objId) delay = 0.5 end
tempTimer(delay, function() callback() end) end
local function scheduleCommands(commands, label, objId, postIdentifyContext) if #commands == 0 then return end local gap = 0.25 m_Enchanter.info(label .. ": " .. table.concat(commands, " ; ")) for i, command in ipairs(commands) do tempTimer(gap * i, function() m_Enchanter.sendAndNote(command) end) end if objId then m_Enchanter.schedulePostOperationIdentify(objId, gap * #commands + 0.5, postIdentifyContext) end end
function m_Enchanter.resolveForAction(arg) arg = trim(arg) if arg == "" then if m_Enchanter.last and m_Enchanter.last.id and m_Enchanter.last.id ~= "" then return m_Enchanter.last.id, m_Enchanter.last end return nil, nil end
local objId if arg:match("^%d+$") then objId = m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(arg, { displaySearch = false }) else objId = m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(arg, { displaySearch = false }) end if not objId then return nil, nil end local analysis = m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, { display = false, report = false }) return objId, analysis end
function m_Enchanter.eqEnchant(arg) if not m_Enchanter.focusAllowsEnchant() then return end
arg = trim(arg) local fastArg = arg:match("^fast%s+(.+)$") if fastArg then m_Enchanter.eqEnchantFast(fastArg) return elseif arg == "fast" then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqenchant fast <id|name>") return end
local objId, analysis = m_Enchanter.resolveForAction(arg) if not objId or not analysis then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqenchant [id|name] after 'eqanalyze <id|name>'.") return end
local target = quoteTarget(objId) local commands = {} if analysis.hasInvis and not analysis.hasSolidified then table.insert(commands, "cast solidify " .. target) end if (not analysis.hasHum) and not analysis.hasResonated then table.insert(commands, "cast resonate " .. target) end if (not analysis.hasGlow) and not analysis.hasIlluminated then table.insert(commands, "cast illuminate " .. target) end
if #commands == 0 then if analysis.pending and analysis.pending ~= "" then m_Enchanter.warn("Run 'eqsetflags confirm' first, then analyze again before enchanting.") return end m_Enchanter.warn("Nothing to enchant for " .. analysis.plainName .. " (flags/enchants do not permit).") return end
m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, function() scheduleCommands(commands, "Queueing enchants", objId, { kind = "enchant" }) end) end
function m_Enchanter.eqEnchantFast(arg) if not m_Enchanter.focusAllowsEnchant() then return end
local objId if arg:match("^%d+$") then objId = m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(arg, { displaySearch = false }) else objId = m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(arg, { displaySearch = false }) end if not objId then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqenchant fast <id|name>") return end
local target = quoteTarget(objId) m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, function() scheduleCommands({ "cast solidify " .. target, "cast resonate " .. target, "cast illuminate " .. target, }, "Queueing enchants (fast)", objId, { kind = "enchant" }) end) end
function m_Enchanter.eqDisenchant(rest) if not m_Enchanter.focusAllowsEnchant() then return end
rest = trim(rest) if rest == "" then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqdisenchant [id|name] <all|solidify|resonate|illuminate> ...") return end
local tokens = {} for token in rest:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(tokens, token) end
local valid = { solidify = true, resonate = true, illuminate = true } local itemTokens, params = {}, {} local hasAll = false for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do local lower = token:lower() if valid[lower] then table.insert(params, lower) elseif lower == "all" then hasAll = true else table.insert(itemTokens, token) end end
if hasAll then params = { "solidify", "resonate", "illuminate" } end if #params == 0 then m_Enchanter.warn("Please specify 'all' or at least one of: solidify, resonate, illuminate.") return end
local itemArg = table.concat(itemTokens, " ") local objId, analysis = m_Enchanter.resolveForAction(itemArg) if not objId then m_Enchanter.warn("No item specified and no previous eqanalyze item remembered.") return end
local target = quoteTarget(objId) local pretty = { solidify = "Solidify", resonate = "Resonate", illuminate = "Illuminate" } local commands = {} local removedNames = {} for _, param in ipairs(params) do table.insert(commands, "disenchant " .. target .. " " .. pretty[param] .. " confirm") table.insert(removedNames, pretty[param]) end m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, function() scheduleCommands(commands, "Queueing disenchants", objId, { kind = "disenchant", removedNames = removedNames, plainName = analysis and analysis.plainName or nil, }) end) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Mudlet alias/trigger registration ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function killKnownIds(t, killFn) for key, id in pairs(t or {}) do if id then pcall(killFn, id) end t[key] = nil end end
function m_Enchanter.registerAliases() killKnownIds(m_Enchanter.aliases, killAlias)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqanalyze = tempAlias([[^eqanalyze(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqAnalyze(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqa = tempAlias([[^eqa(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqAnalyze(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqsetflags = tempAlias([[^eqsetflags(?:\s+(confirm))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqSetFlags(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqreport = tempAlias([[^eqreport\s+(on|off)$]], function() m_Enchanter.setReport((matches[2] or ""):lower()) end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqreportchannel = tempAlias([[^eqreportchannel\s+(.+)$]], function() m_Enchanter.setReportChannel(matches[2] or "echo") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqquiet = tempAlias([[^eqquiet\s+(on|off)$]], function() m_Enchanter.setQuiet((matches[2] or ""):lower()) end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqenchant = tempAlias([[^eqenchant(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqEnchant(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqdisenchant = tempAlias([[^eqdisenchant(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqDisenchant(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqfocus = tempAlias([[^eqfocus$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqFocus() end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqfocusignore = tempAlias([[^eqfocusignore\s+(on|off)$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqFocusIgnore((matches[2] or ""):lower()) end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqsetup = tempAlias([[^eqsetup\s+race\s+(.+)$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqSetupRace(matches[2] or "") end) end
function m_Enchanter.registerTriggers() killKnownIds(m_Enchanter.triggers, killTrigger)
m_Enchanter.triggers.focusTimer = tempRegexTrigger( [[^\s*Enchanters\s+focus\s*:\s*100% enchanters focus \((\d{2}):(\d{2})\)\s*$]], function() m_Enchanter.onFocusTimer(matches[2], matches[3]) end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.noAffects = tempRegexTrigger( [[^You are not affected by any skills or spells\.$]], function() m_Enchanter.onNoAffects() end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.focusFaded = tempRegexTrigger( [[^Your enchanters focus fades\.$]], function() m_Enchanter.onFocusFaded() end ) end
function m_Enchanter.registerEvents() if not registerAnonymousEventHandler then m_Enchanter.warn("Mudlet event handlers are unavailable; post-identify reports need DINV.identifyComplete.") return end
if m_Enchanter.events.dinvIdentifyComplete and not killAnonymousEventHandler then return end
if m_Enchanter.events.dinvIdentifyComplete and killAnonymousEventHandler then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, m_Enchanter.events.dinvIdentifyComplete) m_Enchanter.events.dinvIdentifyComplete = nil end
m_Enchanter.events.dinvIdentifyComplete = registerAnonymousEventHandler("DINV.identifyComplete", "m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyComplete") end
function m_Enchanter.initialize() m_Enchanter.loadSettings() m_Enchanter.registerAliases() m_Enchanter.registerTriggers() m_Enchanter.registerEvents() m_Enchanter.info("v" .. m_Enchanter.version .. " loaded. Use 'eqanalyze help' or 'eqa help'.") end
m_Enchanter.initialize()
